_note: Song select and difficulty select timings. Times in milliseconds (_ms) or seconds (_s), speeds per second, distances in 1920x1080 pixels, opacities from 0 to 1. Easings are a counter's SetEasing mode and curve. Staggers are phase offsets in radians (or in cycles for the glints) per item.

preview._note: the song preview's volume fades, and the wait after a selection before its jacket and preview load

screen_transition._note: song select <-> difficulty select: the panels scroll a screen width in duration_s; song select fades out over the first fade_px, difficulty select fades in over the last fade_px

selected_arrows._note: the arrows around the selected bar (and the AI level arrows) bounce distance_px along angle_deg

level_tag._note: the animated level tags (vault, fire, storm, checker): frame_count rows, one loop every loop_s

ura_fade._note: the Ura/Edit difficulty icon of the song info blinks: a counter runs from cycle down to 0 at speed_per_s, the icon's opacity (0-255) is min(value - fade_in_from, cycle - value)

puchi._note: frame_count frames side by side in the puchi texture, one loop every frame_loop_s; the bob's amplitude and speed

folder_anim._note: opening a folder: the parent siblings slide out to offscreen_left_x, then the contents fan out; closing: the contents group at the focus, then the siblings slide back in

preimage._note: the jacket pops in from pop_start_scale to 1

song_info._note: the song speed arrows pulse once per beat of the sped-up song, clamped to speed_beat_min_ms..speed_beat_max_ms

background._note: the crossfade between background sets, the sets blended at once while scrolling fast, the scroll speeds of the shared background and of bg1.png, and the particle twinkle / ray flicker: base + amount * sin(...)

note._note: the Note frame floats and sways: phase speed, drift / bob amplitudes in px (the drift at float_freq_x times the bob's frequency), sway amplitude in degrees and its phase

level._note: the high-level gauge pulse and space overlay frames, and the level stars' shine and glints

rank_shine._note: the medal ranks shine like the level stars, three times slower

unlock._note: the details card opening or closing, the point of the opening from which the condition text fades in, and the red flash of a failed unlock
